description: Downloads a public document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT, CSV, HTML, XML, images) up to 10 MB and returns its content as clean Markdown for LLM use. Images are described by a vision model. 0.005 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: document_to_markdown
